response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and a clear passion for tooling and developer productivity, but his resume shows minimal direct experience with Java/Kotlin, JVM internals, Spring, or enterprise IDE tooling — the core requirements of the role. His DLang and Node.js focus, while impressive, doesn't align with the JVM-centric technical scope.
strengths: Proven track record in developer tooling and IDE-adjacent projects (e.g., test runners, CI/CD setup)
Strong communication and teaching skills with public workshops on web internals and testing
Experience with complex systems and cross-platform development across multiple languages and environments
concerns: Lacks demonstrated experience with Java/Kotlin enterprise frameworks (Spring, Hibernate, Quarkus)
No evidence of work on IDE internals, language servers, or JVM tooling pipelines
Primary tech stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang, with Java appearing only as a minor or historical skill
